capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Porsche MY2027 release: Performance Battery Plus (105 kWh) now standard across all variants.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: same 105 kWh pack as 2025 (InsideEVs usable 97.0); MY2027 release shows no pack change.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: The Weekly Driver lists the 105 kWh pack as NMC 811 (third-party).

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: 105 kWh Plus pack rated up to 320 kW in 2025 (Porsche US); MY2027 release page prints "320 kWh" (unit typo) and no change is described.

published_10_80_min.notes: Estimated: 18 min 10-80% for the 105 kWh pack in 2025 (Porsche US); not restated for MY2027.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: 2025 US on-board charger 9.6 kW; MY2027 release does not mention AC. 2025 compared.
